overview: Broadcast Ad Break Reconciliation addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in media and entertainment operations. The first proof of value uses scheduled ads, as-run logs and commercial orders. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is unbilled or misplayed ad value, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: scheduled ads, as-run logs and commercial orders; define unbilled or misplayed ad value and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Media CTO / Rights and Editorial Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
